description: Ex-US Navy Crusader used as an eyecatcher on the roadside at Anne Raquel's Resort, at the Bataan-Zambales boundary gate on the Olongapo-Dinalupihan road; Wikipedia describes the same aircraft as being in a public park at Dinalupihan. Marked BuNo 145544 and modex UE-12, both false - the real 145544 was an F-8B lost at sea off Okinawa in 1968. Most likely 150911, an F-8J destroyed by fire at Cubi Point on 8 September 1975. Repainted dark grey with MAVERICK titles in 2020-21, replacing the earlier gull grey/white VC-5 scheme; fitted with a non-standard pointed nose and missing the exhaust nozzle. tail_number left blank because the identification is inferential.
